phase: Phase 7G Step 3 — Transformation Leakage and Integrity Audit

test_1_temporal_causality.details: Verified 100% bitwise identity for earlier windows when future and concurrent sibling telemetry was corrupted.

test_2_zero_label_contamination.details: Verified that transformers execute independently of ground-truth label or time_to_failure columns.

test_3_partition_isolation.details: Verified zero job overlap across Candidate A split boundaries.

test_4_cluster_fallback_parity.details: All windows with insufficient history strictly preserve the frozen Phase 7C cluster scaler.

test_5_permutation_invariance.details: Verified 100% mathematical invariance to row shuffling. Ordering is strictly temporal.

test_6_ledger_consistency.details: Verified 100% structural and logical consistency of hierarchical ledger.
